analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 36.2 entering oversold territory, recovering from 24.3 five days ago. 5-day low of $4.64 is higher than 20-day low of $4.28, forming a Higher Low pattern. ADX at 32.8 indicates a clear trend, but -DI at 29.8 is stronger than +DI at 17.2. A buy signal requires confirmation of MACD histogram improvement.
